message.content: {"caption":"Archive-tree diagram and iteration progress chart for DGM without open-ended exploration.","description":"The picture has two panels. Left, “DGM w/o Open-ended exploration Archive Tree”: many small, numbered circular agent nodes form a tree that runs from an upper-left root down and to the right, ending in a short horizontal row. Thin gray connections indicate which parent agent produced each offspring; no arrowheads or connection labels are visible. Each node’s center color represents its SWE-bench score, on the adjacent blue-to-yellow scale from 0 to 0.5. Border colors indicate evaluation coverage: red for 10 tasks (no basic functionality), orange for 60 tasks, and green for 200 tasks (score ≥0.4 and among the top two in the archive). The legend also shows an outlined star for the final best agent; no individual node can be identified confidently as bearing a distinct star. The tiny integer IDs inside the nodes are not reliably readable. Right, “DGM w/o Open-ended exploration Progress”: a line chart with Iterations on the x-axis (0–80) and SWE-bench Score on the y-axis (about 0.10–0.50). The legend identifies Average of Archive (orange-red), Best Agent (light orange), and Lineage to Final Best Agent (dark brown). The archive average starts near 0.20, drops to about 0.18 by roughly iteration 10, then stays nearly level with a slight rise toward the end. The best-agent line stays near 0.20 before rising to about 0.23 around iteration 38 and remaining there. The dark lineage is a short, fluctuating sequence: it falls from about 0.20 to roughly 0.12, rises and dips several times, then ends near 0.23 around iteration 38; it has no later plotted
